## Wrong-ML stress test

30 wrong labels injected into the agent (classifier output replaced by a confident wrong class), each run under two conflict policies.

Detection of injected errors (by true fault type):

| truth      |   flagged |   conflict_flag |   error_propagated |
|:-----------|----------:|----------------:|-------------------:|
| Ball       |     0.556 |           0.444 |              0.556 |
| Inner race |     1     |           0.889 |              0.111 |
| Normal     |     1     |           0.667 |              0.333 |
| Outer race |     0.778 |           0.667 |              0.333 |

Overall: 80.0% of wrong predictions were flagged for review (physics conflict 66.7%).

Conflict policy trade-off (`trust_ml` = always report the ML label; `abstain` = report 'Unknown - analyst verification required' when physics contradicts the ML label):

| policy   | injected_error   |   correct |   error_propagated |   abstained |   flagged |
|:---------|:-----------------|----------:|-------------------:|------------:|----------:|
| abstain  | true ML label    |         1 |              0     |       0     |       0.4 |
| abstain  | wrong ML label   |         0 |              0.333 |       0.667 |       0.8 |
| trust_ml | true ML label    |         1 |              0     |       0     |       0.4 |
| trust_ml | wrong ML label   |         0 |              1     |       0     |       0.8 |

`error_propagated` = share of runs whose final answer is a confidently wrong fault type; `abstained` = share answered 'Unknown - verify'.

Metric definitions: see `intellimaintain/evaluation/evaluate.py`. Figures: `reports/figures/ablation.png`, `reports/figures/stress_test.png`.
